verdict.rationale: ChatGPT is itself the built-in assistant, and its docs describe extensive task delegation. 'Work' mode carries larger tasks through to a reviewable result [28], subagents handle independent work [103], and Goal mode supports long-running work [79]. Scheduled and event-triggered tasks run in the background [11, 47], Browser and Computer Use let it take actions [9, 10], and Voice can start and check tasks [51]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the newer delegation features (Work, Goal mode, subagents); community evidence only broadly supports plugin and tool use.
